title: Meno workspace-scan snapshot
description: The structural, paste-safe snapshot written by tools/scan.ts to content/tenants/<tenant>/workspace/YYYY-MM-DD-scan.json. No absolute path, home-directory prefix, or approved-root path ever appears here (docs/specs/subject-finder.md, invariant 2); doc bodies never appear here either (invariant 4) - they travel only through the ephemeral doc-body bundle. Shape owned by lib/workspace-scan.ts; behavior owned by docs/specs/subject-finder.md.

roots.description: One entry per approved root, in scan order.

pending_approval.description: Directory names present since approval that were not scanned - each one individually, never the whole root: every other, approved child is scanned normally.

missing_children.description: Approved child directory names that no longer exist on disk this run - a renamed or deleted approved path, distinct from pending_approval (which names a present but unapproved child). Not required at the schema level for the same legacy-fixture reason status is not required.

status.description: 'ok' unless the approved path itself could not be scanned this run. A non-'ok' status always carries repos_found: 0 and pending_approval: [], since nothing was walked - this field is what tells that apart from a genuinely empty, fully-scanned root. Not required at the schema level, only because tools/test/validate.test.ts carries a hand-written VALID_SCAN fixture predating this field that this subsystem does not own; every snapshot lib/workspace-scan.ts actually produces always carries it (lib/workspace-scan.ts's SnapshotRoot type requires it).

repos.description: Every repository found across every scanned root, flattened - root_label ties an entry back to roots[].

items.$comment: 'substantive' is deliberately not in the required list above, for the same legacy-fixture reason 'status' is not required on roots[] (see below): every snapshot lib/workspace-scan.ts actually produces always carries it, but an older snapshot predating this field must still validate.

deps.description: Dependency names only, never version strings. A scoped npm name outside the public-scope allowlist is recorded as the literal '@private-scope' instead of by name; a module-path name (e.g. Go) whose host is outside the public-module-host allowlist is recorded as the literal 'private-module' instead of by name.

dev_deps.description: Same guard as deps, applied to development-only dependencies.

docs.description: Repository-relative path and byte size only. No body: doc bodies travel exclusively through the ephemeral doc-body bundle, never through this snapshot.

substantive.description: False when this repository carries no dependency manifest, no readme marker, and at most one commit in its history - a directory that is a git repository without being a project (a scratch clone, a throwaway experiment, an installed tool's own cache). Still listed here and still counted in aggregate.total_repos; excluded only from aggregate.marker_coverage, aggregate.dependency_frequency, and aggregate.manifest_coverage's denominators.

total_repos.description: Every repository the scan found, substantive or not - unchanged in meaning by the substantive split below.

substantive_repos.description: Count of total_repos that are substantive (see repos[].substantive). Not required at the schema level, for the same legacy-snapshot reason repos[].substantive is not required - every snapshot lib/workspace-scan.ts actually produces always carries it.

dependency_frequency.description: Dependency name -> count of repositories carrying it (deps and dev_deps combined, deduped per repo), sorted by descending count then ascending name and capped at max_dependency_names. A scoped npm name outside the public-scope allowlist is recorded as '@private-scope' instead of by name; a module-path name whose host is outside the public-module-host allowlist is recorded as 'private-module' instead of by name. Computed over substantive repositories only.

manifest_coverage.description: Manifest kind (e.g. 'npm') -> count of repos carrying at least one manifest of that kind. Computed over substantive repositories only.

marker_coverage.description: Marker name -> a Rate ({value, n, of, reason?}) over substantive_repos (not total_repos), same shape as lib/insights.ts's Rate.

limits.description: Plain-language disclosures the report renders verbatim. Never empty: the standing disclosures are unconditional.
